_doc: Single source of truth for categories. Edit this file to add, move or retire a category, then run `python3 .automation/update_index.py`. cadence: 'daily' or 'weekly' (checked on Mondays, Australia/Brisbane). 'path' is the folder holding the category's README.md. 'scope' is what to research; optional 'out_of_scope' names topics that belong to another category (by id), so items land in one place only.
